title: Requirement validation report
description: The `validation/validation-report.json` store read by coherence.trace.validation_status.load_validation, and the sole source of the executed_evidence health dimension. Every report must declare its own provenance: who or what recorded it, with what command, and -- when a human transcribed it rather than a harness emitting it -- which recorded run the numbers come from. Without that block the file is derived state with no derivation (I-10) whose fields assert a measurement nothing on disk shows was computed (I-02).

run_id.description: Optional; read by coherence.runs.measurement_adapter.measurement_run_status as the projected run's id.

generated_at.description: Optional; read by coherence.runs.measurement_adapter.measurement_run_status as the projected run's updated_at.

recorded_by.description: `harness` means these fields were emitted by code in this repository. `hand` means a human transcribed them from a run's output; the substrate cannot recompute them, so a hand-recorded report must cite the run it transcribes.

command.description: The exact command whose output these entries record.

evidence_manifest.description: Repo-relative path to the evidence/runs manifest for `run_id`, which carries the commit and per-input file hashes for the same event.
